verdict.rationale: Requesty's docs include copy-pasteable code snippets, such as the quickstart base_url swap for the OpenAI SDK, and are machine-readable via llms.txt and .md pages, so some runnable example material exists. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or try-it console, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference/playground, a published OpenAPI spec, in-browser runnable request examples, and independent corroboration.
